review: The camera takes sharp photos in daylight, but the battery barely lasts until the evening.
Call quality is clear and the fingerprint sensor is fast.
The speaker is tinny and the charger stopped working after a month.
I bought it for my mother and she uses it every day.
The room was spotless and the bed was comfortable, although the wifi kept dropping.
Breakfast was disappointing and the staff at the reception were rude.
Great location, a short walk from the station, and the pool is lovely.
The air conditioning was noisy, so we hardly slept.
The noise cancellation is impressive and the ear cushions are soft.
Bass is muddy and the bluetooth connection drops every few minutes.
The carrying case feels cheap, but the sound quality is excellent for the price.
The microphone is fine for calls.
